text_plugin_synopsis: File manager plugin. Browse and safely extract ZIP archives
p_languages_all_supported_for_readme: The current README.md supports the following languages
p_introduction: Archive Browser adds read-only archive browsing to the file manager. It opens ZIP-based containers in a dedicated hierarchy viewer and extracts only the entries selected by the user to an output folder selected through Android Storage Access Framework.
features: Registers a single-file read-only Explorer overflow action through the shared `{{ plugin_action }}` protocol.
Browses archive folders and displays unpacked size, compressed size, CRC, and modification metadata.
Searches normalized entry paths and supports selecting individual files, folders, or all visible entries.
Extracts selected entries to a user-selected SAF tree with progress reporting and cancellation.
Accepts ZIP, JAR, AAR, and WAR containers that use supported ZIP compression methods.
Stages the read-only input in private cache and removes temporary data when the viewer closes.
p_supported_formats: Version 1 recognizes these ZIP-family filename extensions
p_plugin_interface: The host discovers and executes the plugin with the following identities
p_plugin_scope: Version 1 provides a single-file read-only overflow action in the main file manager.
p_security: The plugin requests neither storage nor network permissions. The host grants temporary read-only access to the input content URI, while output access is limited to the SAF directory explicitly selected by the user. Absolute paths, parent traversal, drive prefixes, backslashes, unsafe Unicode, duplicate paths, file-directory conflicts, unsupported compression methods, size mismatches, and CRC mismatches are rejected.
security_limits: Maximum archive path nodes, including implicit directories: `{{ max_entries }}`.
Maximum ZIP central directory size: `{{ max_central_directory_size }}`.
Maximum normalized path length: `{{ max_path_length }}` characters.
Maximum unpacked size for one entry: `{{ max_single_size }}`.
p_build_params: Build parameters come from `version.properties`. The current minimum SDK is 24 and the target SDK is 36
p_resource_layout: `strings.xml` localizes plugin metadata and fixed browser text, while `plurals.xml` localizes quantity-aware browser text. `plugin_instruction.md` provides host-visible usage instructions. README and changelog files are generated from JSON sources by `.python/generate_markdown.py`
